messages:
pm_jess: Quick kickoff — Q2 hosted API scope bets. Need to lock ship criteria for chat/completions, embeddings, and a small rerank pilot by EOD Friday. Can we surface the biggest must-haves vs nice-to-haves?
eng_raj: +1. I'll summarize infra constraints: GPU capacity, latency SLOs, and rollout risk. TL;DR: embeddings is cheap CPU-wise but memory-heavy for cache; chat needs KV cache improvements.
lina: UX asks: streaming + partial results for SDKs is a must for chat adoption. Also clearer error semantics for rate-limits.
sam: From analytics: top 5 customers expect <150ms median for short chat flows; embeddings latency tolerance is higher but cost per 1M vectors is the driver.
yara: Evaluation note — we need guardrails on rerank: quality thresholds (NDCG lift) + fallback to baseline when confidence low. We should define the eval dataset.
pm_jess: Good. Proposal: 3 buckets — "Critical (must ship)", "High (ship if capacity/seq)" and "Backlog". Draft criteria: pass infra SLOs, regression <2% on quality for host customers, clear rollout plan + canary, and docs + SDK samples. Thoughts?
eng_raj: Sounds right. For infra SLOs: p50 <120ms for chat small prompt, p99 <1.2s; embeddings p50 <300ms. If we can't hit p99 we require a staged rollout and customer opt-in.
ana_cs: (ana_cs) From CS: customers want predictable cost and perf. We should include pricing guidance and migration notes in the launch checklist. Also flag the few enterprise requests for private deployments.
lina: UX checklist add: SDK streaming examples, human-readable error codes, and migration guide (v1 -> v2 param mapping).
sam: Metric to track pre/post launch: cost per 1k tokens, median latency, model answer regression rate, and percentage of requests using caching.
yara: For rerank pilot: propose 2 customer cohorts, run A/B for 4 weeks, success = +5% CTR on suggested answers or +0.03 NDCG absolute. Fallback if model confidence <0.6.
eng_raj: Implementation notes: need KV cache prefetch optimization (PR open), dynamic batching improvements, and a light-weight quantized embedding runner for Dedicated. ETA: KV PR by Wed, batching next sprint.
pm_jess: OK can we map owners + deadlines: eng_raj infra owner, lina UX, sam metrics, yara evals, ana_cs customer comms. Target alpha: 2026-06-12. Beta: 2026-07-10. GA: 2026-08-21. Anyone blocked?
eng_raj: Blocker: Dedicated cluster slot for load testing — ops-bot, can we reserve 2x A100 for the week of 6/3?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Request submitted to infra for 2x A100 reservation for 2026-06-03 to 2026-06-10. ETA approval 24h.
nana_cs: We have one enterprise pilot who wants earlier access — can we offer a controlled canary in late May?
eng_raj: Maybe if we spin up a smaller canary on CPU with quantized embeddings and reduced seq len. Risk: not representative for p99.
pm_jess: Tradeoff noted. Let's keep enterprise canary but mark it explicitly not meeting p99. Docs must say that.
sam: Also recommend a cost-control knob: max tokens per request + per-tenant rate limits as part of launch. We should include default quotas.
ly: (yara) small nit: add automated quality regression alerts tied to eval prompts — if drift > 1% on anchor set, rollback.
pm_jess: Agreed. I'll draft the launch checklist and ship criteria doc now and post a link. Action items: eng_raj (infra plan + reservation), lina (SDK streaming examples), sam (dashboards + cost metrics), yara (eval dataset + thresholds), ana_cs (customer comms & pricing blurb).
eng_raj: I'll post infra plan by EOD Tuesday.
lina: I'll prototype SDK streaming snippet today.
sam: Dashboard stub by Thursday.
yara: Eval harness and initial anchor set by Friday.
nana_cs: I'll prepare customer comms and migration FAQ by Friday.
pm_jess: Thanks all. If no objections we'll lock scope tomorrow AM and publish OKR-linked tasks. :thumbsup:
eng_raj: +1
lina: +1
sam: +1
yara: +1
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder — engineering oncall rota updated for the week of 2026-06-01.
pm_jess: Noted. Closing thread for action tracking, will create GH epic and link tasks.
